postings.conferenceText: 18th International Conference on Wireless & Mobile Network (WiMo 2026)October 24 ~ 25, 2026, Vienna, AustriaScope & Topics18th International Conference on Wireless & Mobile Network (WiMo 2026) is dedicated to addressing the challenges in the areas of wireless & mobile networks. The Conference looks for significant contributions to the Wireless and Mobile computing in theoretical and practical aspects. The Wireless and Mobile computing domain emerges from the integration among personal computing, networks, communication technologies, cellular technology, and the Internet Technology. The modern applications are emerging in the area of mobile ad hoc networks and sensor networks. This Conference is intended to cover contributions in both the design and analysis in the context of mobile, wireless, ad-hoc, and sensor networks. The goal of this Conference is to bring together researchers and practitioners from academia and industry to focus on advanced wireless and Mobile computing concepts and establishing new collaborations in these areas. Authors are solicited to contribute to the conference by submitting articles that illustrate research results, projects, surveying works and industrial experiences that describe significant advances in the areas of wireless, mobile networks.Topics of interest include, but are not limited to, the following5G/6G Network Architectures and Terahertz/mmWave SystemsAI Native Wireless, LLM Driven Network Agents and Zero Touch AutomationAR/VR/XR and Holographic Telepresence over Wireless NetworksBlockchain for Wireless and Mobile NetworksGraph Neural Networks and Reinforcement Learning for Wireless OptimizationGreen, Sustainable and Energy Neutral Wireless SystemsIntegrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) and RF PerceptionInterference Management, Spectrum Sharing and Dynamic AccessIoT, Smart Cities, Cyber Physical Systems and Sensor NetworksMobile Edge Computing (MEC), Edge AI and Split ComputingNetwork Digital Twins, Radio Digital Twins and Wireless ResilienceNetwork Slicing, Virtualization, SDN and P4 Programmable WirelessNon Terrestrial Networks (NTN), SAGIN and LEO Mega ConstellationsOpen RAN (O RAN), RIC, xAppsandrAppsQuality of Service (QoS), Scheduling and Performance OptimizationReconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) and Cell Free Massive MIMOTracking, Localization and Cooperative Wireless PerceptionVehicular Networks (V2X) and Autonomous Mobility CommunicationsWireless Security, AI Driven Threat Detection and Post Quantum ProtectionWireless Support for Distributed AI Training and Federated LearningPaper SubmissionAuthors are invited to submit papers through the conference Submission System by September 26, 2026. postings.conferenceText: SOICT 2026 is an international symposium covering significant research areas that include AI Foundations and Big Data, Networking and Communication Technologies, Multimedia Processing, AI Applications, Generative AI, Applied Operations Research and Optimization, Recent Advances in Cyber Security. Following the past successful symposium SOICT 2025, which received submissions from 26 countries, the 15th International Symposium on Information and Communication Technology (SOICT 2026) will be held in Ho Chi Minh city, Vietnam on 4, 5 December 2026. The symposium aims to provide an academic forum for researchers and graduate students to share their latest research findings and identify future computer science challenges. The symposium will include tutorials and keynotes given by world-class speakers. SOICT 2026 proceedings will be published in the Springer CCIS series. The Proceedings of SOICT 2026 will be indexed in DBLP, Google Scholar, EI-Compendex, Mathematical Reviews, SCImago, Scopus and submitted for inclusion in ISI Proceedings.

postings.conferenceText: 8th International Conference on Advancements in Computational Sciences(ICACS’27)Lahore, Pakistan2-3 February 2027http://sites.uol.edu.pk/icacs27Organizer: THE UNIVERSITY OF LAHORETechnical Co-Sponsorship: IEEE Lahore Section, IEEE ComSoc Lahore Chapter & IEEE Computer Society Lahore The conference will be in hybrid mode. The International authors can present their papers physically or online. However, it is mandatory for the local authors to be present at the conference.About ICACS’27The University of Lahore is going to organize the 8th International Conference on Advancements in Computational Sciences (ICACS’27) on 2-3 February 2027, both physical and virtual, in Lahore, Pakistan. The University of Lahore is the largest private university located in Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan. The purpose of ICACS’27 is to bring together academia representatives, researchers, students, scientists, and IT industrialists around the world for advances, innovations, and newly emerging trends in Computer Science. The experts are invited to deliver their keynote talks and session talks related to the 9 major tracks listed below.ICACS’27 Major TracksThe nine major tracks of ICACS’27 include (but are not limited to):- Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning- Natural Language Processing- Computer Vision and Multimedia- Data Science and Knowledge Systems- Cybersecurity, Privacy and Digital Forensics- Software Engineering and Human-Centered Computing- Internet of Things, Networks and Emerging Technologies- Robotics, Autonomous Systems and Digital Twins- Remote Sensing, Geospatial Intelligence and Earth ObservationAll accepted papers will be submitted to IEEE for publication at the IEEE Xplore Digital Library and indexed in DBLP. Further extended versions of high quality accepted papers will be considered for publication in the Special issue of Journal of Computational Science and Applications (JSCA) - Y Category.All previous editions of the conference (ICACS 2018, ICACS 2019, ICACS 2020, ICACS 2023, ICACS 2024, ICACS 2025, ICACS 2026) had their proceedings indexed and published by IEEEXplore. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/xpl/conhome/1825184/all-proceedings*IMPORTANT DATES*Paper Submission Deadline: September 25th, 2026Acceptance Notification: December 10th, 2026Camera Ready Submission: December 28th, 2026Early Bird Registration: January 5th, 2027Please use the following link for paper submission:https://easychair.org/conferences?conf=icacs27Should you require more information about ICACS’27 or event details, please visit our conference website at https://sites.uol.edu.pk/icacs27/. You may also contact us at icacs@cs.uol.edu.pk.We shall be looking forward to your paper contributions and participation. Let us meet in the historical city "LAHORE-PAKISTAN" with its unique beauty, history, culture, and international lifestyle! We hope that your stay in the historic city will be very pleasant.Please share the conference details with your colleagues, research group members, and fellow scientists.Regards,------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Prof. Dr. Muhammad Atif,Chair - 8th International Conference on Advancements in Computational Sciences (ICACS’27)The University of Lahore,1-KM Defence Road, Lahore, Pakistan.

postings.conferenceText: International Conference on Buddhonomics 2026 Theme: Partnering for Prosperity, Posterity, and Peace 20–22 November 2026 | IIM Bodh Gaya, Bihar, India Pre-Conference Workshop: 19 November 2026 The conference invites researchers, academicians, practitioners, and policymakers to submit original research addressing the principles and applications of Buddhonomics and their relevance to contemporary economic and managerial challenges. The conference welcomes research on sustainable and mindful development, peace and harmony, ethical governance, responsible innovation, moral institutions, cultural and spiritual dimensions of economics, and contemporary issues in economics and management. Abstract Submission Deadline: 30 September 2026 Acceptance Notification: By 5 October 2026 For submission guidelines and further details, please visit the conference website. *Deadline Extended: Call for Abstracts – International Conference on Buddhonomics 2026* 🏛️ *IIM Bodh Gaya, Bihar* | 📅 *20–22 November 2026* *Pre-conference workshop:* *19 November 2026* The conference, organized by *IIM Bodh Gaya* in collaboration with *Nalanda University* and the *University of Colombo*, seeks to integrate Buddhist wisdom with contemporary perspectives in economics, management, governance, and development under the theme: ✨ *“Partnering for Prosperity, Posterity, and Peace.”* ✨ *Submission tracks:* 1. Buddhonomics – Reimagining the Global Economic Order 2. Sustainable and Mindful Development 3. Peace, Prosperity, and Geopolitical Harmony 4. Human Capital, Governance, and Moral Institutions 5. Business, Mindfulness, and Responsible Innovation 6. Cultural, Historical, and Spiritual Dimensions 7. General Management and Economics — Contemporary Perspectives *Best Paper Award:* Cash prizes worth ₹45,000 + fast-tracked publication opportunities and engagement with scholars, policymakers, and industry leaders. 📚 *Submit here:* https://tinyurl.com/5eefsfmm ⏳ *Abstract submission deadline:* 30th September, 2026 📩 *Acceptance notifications:* Latest by 5th October 📧 *Contact:* [email protected] Faculty, research scholars, and postgraduate students working in management, economics, public policy, governance, or mindfulness-related areas are encouraged to consider submission. remove *

postings.conferenceName: The 1st IEEE International Workshop on AI for Seniors
postings.conferenceText: The deployment of Artificial Intelligence is rapidly transforming industries and our everyday life. This workshop specifically addresses how AI can support aging populations. The intersection of AI and gerontechnology which is technology designed to support older adults, offers new possibilities for healthcare, independence, and social participation to improve quality of life for older people. This workshop brings together researchers, practitioners, designers, and policymakers to explore how AI can enhance technologies for aging societies.The topics include but are not limited to:* AI for Health and Care- AI-assisted diagnosis for aging-related diseases- Predictive health monitoring and wearables- AI-driven telehealth and remote care- Robotics and assistive AI* Smart Environments- Smart homes for aging in place- Sensor-based monitoring systems- Ambient assisted living technologies- AI-powered mobility and accessibility systems* Augmented and Virtual Reality in E-Learning- Augmented Reality application for immersive learning- Virtual Reality for explorative teaching- Machine Learning for adaptive content- Virtual Learning Environments (VLEs)* Cognitive and Social Support- AI companions and conversational agents- Technologies addressing dementia and cognitive decline- Digital tools to reduce loneliness and social isolation* Human-Centered Design- Inclusive design for older adults- Ethical AI and aging- Trust, privacy, and security in elder technologies* Policy and Societal Impact- AI governance for aging societies- Technology adoption among older populations- Cross-cultural perspectives on aging and technology* Explainable and Accessible AI- Technologies to lower the barrier to use AI- Tools to make AI more transparent to elder people- Specific UI approaches for the target group* Lecture Recording, Multimedia Authoring & Classroom Methodology- Automated lecture recording and presentation techniques- Classroom note taking and whiteboard capturing and analysis- Multimedia authoring software for e-learningWorkshop Goal and DesignThe workshop is designed for maximum interaction and will feature a dynamic blend of sessions. The agenda will include:• Keynote Presentations• Invited Talks• Interactive Panel Discussion• Presentations of submitted papers Contributions will be reviewed for quality and relevance to the workshop’s theme. Theoretical and applied papers and papers that capture best practices and lessons learned from field studies are encouraged. Submission of preliminary results would also be considered.Workshop ProceedingsThe workshop solicits regular technical papers of up to 8 pages (IEEE double-column format). Workshop papers will be official publications of IEEE which will be included in IEEEXplore and also be available as printed workshop proceedings. A number of selected papers will be invited for extension and publication in a special issue of ITSE (International Journal of Interactive Technology and Smart Education) published by World Scientific.Submission DetailsPapers must be original and not submitted to or accepted by any other conference or journal. Papers should be submitted in electronic form as PDF file to the organizers. Submissions must be formatted according to the 8.5x11 inch double column IEEE CS proceedings format and must not exceed 8 pages.Submit to: EasyChair (Instructions will be published soon)Important DatesSubmission due: July 30, 2026Notification: August 14, 2026Camera-Ready due: August 21, 2026Co-ChairsChih-Hung Chang, Washington University in St. Louis, USAJulienne Greer, University of California San Diego, USA Pauline N. postings.conferenceName: 2nd International Workshop on Digital Technologies for Smart and Sustainable Buildings
postings.conferenceText: Call for Papers2nd International Workshop on Digital Technologies for Smart and Sustainable Buildings (DTSSB 2026)Co-located with BIR 2026Olten, SwitzerlandOctober 7, 2026Workshop website:https://pros.unicam.it/dtssb/Submission:https://easychair.org/conferences/?conf=bir2026ABOUT THE WORKSHOPSmart buildings are evolving into complex socio-technical systems where IoT infrastructures generate large volumes of data, enabling advanced approaches such as Digital Twins, Artificial Intelligence (AI), semantic modeling, and process mining.DTSSB 2026 aims to bring together researchers and practitioners to explore methods and technologies supporting the design, integration, and operation of smart and sustainable buildings, with a focus on decision-making, interoperability, and data-driven optimization.The workshop welcomes conceptual, technical, application-oriented, and case-study contributions related to digital technologies for smart and sustainable buildings.TOPICSTopics include, but are not limited to:- Digital Twins and IoT for Smart Buildings- Process mining and analysis of IoT data- Semantic models, ontologies, and knowledge graphs- Hybrid and explainable AI- Interoperability between BIM, IoT, and Digital Twins- Energy efficiency and building optimization- Data analytics and decision support for Smart Buildings- Smart Building information systems and architectures- Facility management and building operation optimization- Case studies and industrial applicationsIMPORTANT DATESPaper submission: July 30, 2026 (AoE)Notification: August 30, 2026Workshop date: October 7, 2026Camera-ready submission: October 30, 2026All dates are AoE.SUBMISSION GUIDELINESSubmissions must be original and not published or submitted for publication elsewhere. Papers must be written in English.The workshop welcomes the submission of regular papers and short papers:- Regular papers: 11-15 pages- Short papers: 6-10 pagesSubmissions must be made via EasyChair, using the workshop track:"2nd International Workshop on Digital Technologies for Smart and Sustainable Buildings"https://easychair.org/conferences/?conf=bir2026PUBLICATIONAccepted papers will appear in CEUR-WS proceedings. Selected papers will be invited to submit an extended version to a journal special issue.Further details are available on the workshop website:https://pros.unicam.it/dtssb/ORGANIZERSMassimo Callisto De Donato, University of Camerino, ItalyEmanuele Laurenzi, University of Applied Sciences and Arts Northwestern Switzerland, SwitzerlandSebastiano Maltese, University of Applied Sciences and Arts of Southern Switzerland, SwitzerlandLorenzo Rossi, University of Camerino, Italy

postings.conferenceText: Call for papers/Topics Topics of Interest for Submission include, but are Not Limited to:1. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) Neural Networks and Deep Learning Computer Vision and Natural Language Processing (NLP) Cybersecurity & Cryptography Blockchain and Decentralized Ledgers Zero-trust Architecture Quantum-resistant Encryption Quantum Computing Quantum Bit (Qubit) Development Cryogenic Engineering for Computing Internet of Things (IoT) Edge Computing Smart Sensors and Actuators 2.
